chunks: Then the Pharaoh followed them with his army, but the sea overpowered and engulfed them.
ai.seo_question: How did Pharaoh and his army meet their end after pursuing the Children of Israel?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Taa-Haa, this verse marks the climax of the divine retribution where Pharaoh's pursuit leads to his ultimate demise, fulfilling the promise of victory for the believers. Shia exegesis often highlights this as a manifestation of Allah's power to overwhelm the arrogant with the very element they sought to cross, serving as a timeless archetype of the triumph of truth over tyranny.
